remarks: Charming East Norwalk Home - Move-In Ready & Perfectly Located! Nestled in the highly desirable East Norwalk neighborhood, this beautifully maintained single-family home sits on a corner flat lot! Enjoy a private backyard space, and stunning curb appeal. Overflowing with charm, this home offers 3 bedrooms 2/1 baths and a glorious sunroom that floods the space with natural light. It provides a bright, inviting space to enjoy morning coffee, curl up with a book, use as an office or as a flexible area. In addition the home has a cozy living room complete with a fireplace nook and built-in shelving ideal for displaying books, family photos, or treasured decor. Imagine winter evenings by the fire in this ultimate relaxing space, or summer nights enjoying the outdoor space -savoring moments together in a home that truly feels special. The large eat in kitchen makes daily life and entertaining effortless . Close to East Norwalk's best attractions and you can walk to beaches, marinas, top-rated restaurants, and commuter-friendly train stations. The location provides convenience at your doorstep, with leisure and travel options just minutes away! This is more than just a house-it's the backdrop for your best memories to come. Homes in this area move fast-schedule your private showing today!
